assurance_case_justification: The current security-assurance argument is documented in SECURITY_AUDIT.md: separation of API secrets into nr-vault, authorization gates, trust-zone ceilings, write approval, output redaction and network-egress boundaries, with related ADRs and test-backed controls. It explicitly identifies defaults that remain open, the SSRF boundary for model-supplied URLs, limits of scoped reviews and unresolved decisions. This evidence is the current assurance surface; the archived January audit and its zero-finding counts are not asserted as current. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/SECURITY_AUDIT.md and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/Documentation/Adr/Adr113FailClosedToolDataClassEnforcement.rst.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: The CI workflow enables TYPO3 functional tests for the supported PHP/TYPO3 matrix and a MariaDB leg, and invokes property-based tests. The E2E workflow invokes the browser test setup for TYPO3 through the shared workflow. Composer scripts also expose the integration suite. This answer does not assume that the existence of a suite means it contributes coverage on every event. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/.github/workflows/e2e.yml and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/composer.json.
bus_factor_justification: A bus factor of at least two has not been established by the available evidence. Organization-level backup access addresses access continuity but does not by itself establish that a second person has sufficient project knowledge to sustain maintenance. The current project document describes a solo-maintainer model. The former Dependabot reviewer assignment is no longer evidence because .github/dependabot.yml was removed. This answer does not infer personnel competence from commit counts. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/21d17f3a29d6b99192535876376dc3e1d6bdc1b3/.github/SECURITY_CONTROLS.md#succession-planning and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/pull/939.
code_review_standards_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents review expectations covering code quality, tests, security and documentation. The PR-quality workflow is now invoked by checks.yml through the shared organization workflow; the former local pr-quality.yml link is obsolete. These documented standards are distinct from proof that the separate two-person-review threshold is met. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/.github/workflows/checks.yml.
coding_standards_enforced_justification: The CI workflow invokes the shared PHP-CS-Fixer, PHPStan and Rector checks; their corresponding required contexts are listed in the project's security-assurance document. This replaces the obsolete GrumPHP-specific evidence. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/SECURITY_AUDIT.md.
dependency_monitoring_justification: Renovate is configured through the versioned renovate.json and the shared Netresearch preset. checks.yml invokes shared Composer audit and pull-request dependency-review workflows. The current security-assurance document identifies these checks and their gate. This replaces the removed Dependabot configuration and does not claim the former GrumPHP security checker remains active. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/renovate.json, https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/.github/workflows/checks.yml and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/SECURITY_AUDIT.md.
documentation_security_justification: SECURITY.md documents private vulnerability reporting, the response process and user security guidance. SECURITY_AUDIT.md documents current security boundaries, test-backed controls, limitations and scoped review outcomes; it explicitly separates the archived January 2026 self-audit from current assurance. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/SECURITY.md and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/SECURITY_AUDIT.md.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Dynamic testing includes TYPO3 functional tests, browser E2E tests and property-based tests. Infection mutation testing runs on the weekly CI schedule and is explicitly report-only at present. These are the documented runtime-testing mechanisms; this does not claim comprehensive fuzzing or universal vulnerability detection. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/.github/workflows/e2e.yml.
governance_justification: The documented contribution and agent workflows do not by themselves establish the project's governance model. The reviewed CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md describe development and review expectations, but this review did not establish a clear public statement identifying final decision authority, the key governance roles and how disputes are resolved. A short project-specific governance statement is needed, or an existing authoritative statement should be linked. The former local pr-quality.yml link has also been superseded by checks.yml. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md, https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/AGENTS.md and https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/11697/1#governance.
hardened_site_justification: The project homepage and repository URLs registered for this badge are hosted on GitHub; release downloads are published through GitHub Releases. On 2026-09-21 the repository response included Content-Security-Policy with default-src 'none' and frame-ancestors 'none', Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and X-Frame-Options: deny. GitHub is also explicitly identified by this criterion's guidance as a site known to meet it. CI scanning and action pinning are not the evidence for this header requirement. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm and https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/11697/2#hardened_site.
hardening_justification: Runtime hardening of the software produced by this project has not been established by the evidence reviewed. The previous answer listed CI scanners, runner hardening and action pinning; these do not demonstrate this criterion, which concerns mechanisms in the delivered software such as applicable security headers or runtime mitigations. A concrete description of the mechanisms inherited from TYPO3 or enabled by the extension, their applicable deployment conditions and their verification is needed. This does not claim that no runtime hardening exists. See https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/11697/1#hardening and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/SECURITY_AUDIT.md.
implement_secure_design_justification: Current documented design controls include nr-vault secret isolation, narrowing authorization gates, fail-closed trust-zone checks, human approval for writing tools, output redaction and egress restrictions. SECURITY_AUDIT.md links the relevant ADRs and tests and explicitly distinguishes controls that fail closed from configuration defaults that remain open. The historical sodium_crypto_secretbox implementation and January audit findings are not used as claims about current code. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/SECURITY_AUDIT.md and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/Documentation/Adr/Adr134WriteEffectImpliesApproval.rst.
maintenance_or_update_justification: The project is actively maintained. The current release verified on 2026-09-21 is v0.35.0, published 2026-09-16; main also contains subsequent maintenance updates. Dependency-update configuration is now Renovate rather than the removed Dependabot configuration. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/releases/tag/v0.35.0, https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/commits/main and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/renovate.json.

This enforces MFA for organisation members and outside collaborators accessing organisation repositories. The setting may not be visible to anonymous API clients.

signed_releases_justification: Release v0.35.0 provides archives, SHA256 checksums, SPDX/CycloneDX SBOMs and corresponding .sigstore.json bundles. The verified SLSA provenance/v1 identifies that workflow at refs/heads/main and the v0.35.0 source tag. static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: PHP security analysis uses Opengrep through the shared security workflow invoked by checks.yml. PHPStan level 10 provides additional PHP type and architecture analysis. CodeQL analyzes GitHub Actions and JavaScript/TypeScript, not PHP. The current security-assurance document identifies the applicable checks and their required gate. This answer does not claim that Psalm, Trivy or every historical scanner is currently enforced. test_branch_coverage80_justification: Applicable, but the required 80% branch coverage has not been established. PHPUnit can collect branch coverage using Xdebug; PCOV only provides line coverage. The Codecov report for commit 21d17f3a29d6b99192535876376dc3e1d6bdc1b3 has no branch metrics (branches: 0), which is not a measurement of 0% branch coverage. A branch-enabled coverage report is needed. See https://docs.phpunit.de/en/13.4/code-coverage.html and https://app.codecov.io/gh/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/commit/21d17f3a29d6b99192535876376dc3e1d6bdc1b3.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: ci.yml is triggered for pushes to main, pull requests, merge groups, manual runs and the weekly schedule. It invokes shared workflows for the PHP/TYPO3 test matrix and property-based tests. e2e.yml likewise covers pull requests and merge groups as well as its scheduled/manual events; E2E testing is not limited to the weekly run. Event gates in the shared workflows may avoid redundant runs. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/.github/workflows/e2e.yml.
test_invocation_justification: The authoritative local entry points use the Docker test runner and Make targets: make test-unit, make test-integration, make test-func and make test-fuzzy delegate to Build/Scripts/runTests.sh; make mutation and make coverage expose the corresponding modes. AGENTS.md documents direct runner invocations such as ./Build/Scripts/runTests.sh -s unit and requires using that environment instead of directly invoking PHPUnit/PHPStan/Rector. Browser E2E testing uses ddev e2e or the documented runner invocation with TYPO3_BASE_URL. Composer scripts also exist for the configured environment, but are not a replacement for these local runner rules. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/AGENTS.md, https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/Makefile and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#testing-requirements.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: For commit 21d17f3a29d6b99192535876376dc3e1d6bdc1b3, Codecov reports 29,309 covered of 33,537 executable-line entries (87.39%), using the uploaded PHPUnit/Clover reports. PHPUnit's Clover writer represents executable/executed lines as statements/coveredstatements, and Codecov imports those entries as line coverage; the Codecov field name alone does not denote a different underlying PHP coverage measure. This figure applies to the configured PHP source scope, whose exclusions include Domain/Model and Domain/Enum. Functional reports are uploaded on scheduled/manual runs and may be carried forward. Codecov's configured status thresholds are informational. See https://app.codecov.io/gh/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/commit/21d17f3a29d6b99192535876376dc3e1d6bdc1b3, https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/21d17f3a29d6b99192535876376dc3e1d6bdc1b3/Build/FunctionalTests.xml and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/21d17f3a29d6b99192535876376dc3e1d6bdc1b3/codecov.yml.
test_statement_coverage90_justification: The verified report for commit 21d17f3a29d6b99192535876376dc3e1d6bdc1b3 reports 87.39% coverage (29,309 of 33,537 executable-line entries), below 90% for the configured PHP source scope. PHPUnit/Clover represents those line entries as statements and Codecov reports them as line coverage. The source filters and functional carry-forward settings affect the report scope; this is not a claim that every source file is included. Codecov's status configuration is informational and does not enforce a 90% threshold. See https://app.codecov.io/gh/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/commit/21d17f3a29d6b99192535876376dc3e1d6bdc1b3 and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/21d17f3a29d6b99192535876376dc3e1d6bdc1b3/codecov.yml.
tests_documented_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires appropriate tests for all contributions and specifies unit/integration tests for new features, regression tests for bug fixes, and updates for API changes. The CI workflow runs the configured test matrix. Mutation testing is scheduled and currently report-only; it is not claimed to be an enforced merge threshold. See https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#testing-requirements and https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-llm/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml.
two_person_review_justification: Not established. This criterion requires review by another person for at least 50% of proposed modifications before release; automated approvals and AI reviews do not establish that requirement. The project documents a solo-maintainer model with automated compensating controls. A 2026-09-21 sample of 15 recently merged pull requests had only bot approvals; human review entries in that sample were by the respective author. This sample does not establish the historical proportion of modifications reviewed by another person. version_tags_signed_justification: The current release tag v0.35.0 is annotated and GitHub reports verification.verified=true and verification.reason=valid for tag object f7d62763b25862f2fe04a81e6c212023a9a679c6.
